title: Communications, Network, Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Information Technology Services (CNECTS), aka "Connects"
description: The Space Acquisition and Integration Office (SAIO), on behalf of the 21st Communications Squadron (21 CS) under Space Operations Command (SpOC) at Peterson SFB (PSFB), CO, is currently exploring the feasibility of consolidating several communications contracts across PSFB, Schriever SFB (SSFB), and Cheyenne Mountain Space Force Station (CMSFS). 28 July 2026 Updated: SAVE-THE-DATE: CNECTS Pre-Release Virtual Industry Day & One-on-Ones The Space Acquisition and Integration Office (SAIO), on behalf of the 21st Communications Squadron (21 CS), is pleased to announce a Pre-Release Virtual Industry Day for the CNECTS acquisition. This event will provide critical updates on the CNECTS requirement, featuring a comprehensive walk-through of the draft Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) and Area of Interest (AOI) document(s). Additionally, the Government will host virtual One-on-One meetings exclusively for new small business participants that have not had an opportunity to meet with the CNECTS acquisition team to ensure maximum opportunity for emerging partners to discuss their capabilities for he CNECTS requirements. 2. EVENT DATES & DETAILS Virtual Industry Day: Wednesday, 19 August 2026 Format: Virtual Only (MS Teams) Audience: Open to all interested industry partners. Key Focus: Detailed walk-through and Q&A session regarding the CNECTS draft CSO and AOI. Small Business One-on-One Meetings: Thursday, 20 August 2026 & Friday, 21 August 2026 Format: Virtual Only (MS Teams) Eligibility Requirement (CRITICAL): These sessions are strictly reserved for new small business participants that have not previously met with the CNECTS acquisition team. If your company has already engaged in a One-on-One for this requirement, please do not request a slot for these dates. Space is highly limited and will be allocated on a first-come, first-served basis for eligible firms. 3. ONE-ON-ONE REGISTRATION (OPEN NOW) ? Eligible small businesses may begin requesting their 1-on-1 time slots immediately. Space is highly limited and slots will be assigned on a first-come, first-served basis. How to Request: Email the Point of Contact listed below. Required Email Subject Line: CNECTS 1-on-1 Request - [Your Company Name] Information to Include in Request: Company Name & Unique Entity ID (UEI) Primary Point of Contact (Name, Email, Phone) Small Business and/or Socioeconomic Category (e.g., SDVOSB, WOSB, 8(a), HUBZone), if applicable Confirmation Statement: "We confirm that our company has not previously held a One-on-One meeting with the CNECTS acquisition team." 4. NEXT STEPS FOR THE VIRTUAL INDUSTRY DAY For general attendance at the Virtual Industry Day on August 19 (which does not require a 1-on-1 slot), formal MS Teams dial-in links and draft CSO/AOI materials will be posted here in the coming weeks. No registration is required for the main briefings on August 19. 5. POINTS OF CONTACT Submit your One-on-One meeting requests directly to: Primary POC: Rosalind Davis, Contracting Officer � rosalind.davis.3@spaceforce.mi 14 July 2026 Updated: Important Notice to Industry: Immediate Suspension of CMMC Phase II Requirements On behalf of the SAIO Acquisition Team, we want to ensure all industry partners are aware of a major policy announcement issued today by the Department of War (DoW) Chief Information Officer (CIO) and the Under Secretary of War for Acquisition and Sustainment. Effective immediately, the Department has suspended the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Phase II requirements, which were originally scheduled to go into effect on November 10, 2026. What does this mean? While Phase II is suspended to reduce administrative barriers, the Department maintains a strict cybersecurity posture: Phase I Remains Active: All CMMC Phase I self-assessment requirements remain firmly in place. Contractual Enforcement Continues: Contractual enforcement of cybersecurity remains fully active. All defense contractors must still comply with DFARS 252.204-7012, which requires the implementation of NIST SP 800-171 security controls to protect Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). 9 July 2026 Updated: General Status Updated Regarding the Acquisition Path and Timeline We appreciate your continued interest and your patience as we work through the pre-acquisition phases. This correspondence is to provide a general status update regarding the acquisition path and timeline: Current Review Status: The CNECTS follow-on is a highly complex acquisition that consolidates multiple legacy contracts across critical Space Force installations. At this time, several critical reviews and strategy documents have not yet been approved. Path Forward: Because of the technical and structural complexity of this effort, we are working diligently to secure all necessary senior-level approvals. As soon as we obtain a more definitive pathway and approved strategy, we will provide an updated milestone schedule to Industry. A Viable Requirement: We want to emphasize that this remains a highly viable contract action. The Government is fully committed to this consolidated effort and is actively progressing through the required regulatory steps. Virtual Industry Day: Due to the extensive delay between the initial Industry Day and the upcoming release of the CSO/Area of Interest (AOI), the Space Acquisition and Integration Office (SAIO) plans to host a Virtual-Only Industry Day. The purpose of this event will be to walk through the CSO and the specific AOI requirements prior to their release, aiming to address as many questions as possible before the official solicitation goes live. One-on-One Meetings: In conjunction with these updates, one-on-one (1-1) meetings will be offered to any new requesters that have not previously met with the CNECTS acquisition team. Due to high interest and resource constraints, we are unable to accommodate repeat meetings with previously engaged parties. As a reminder, when the solicitation is released, it will be executed as a 100% Small Business Set-Aside using the Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) phased evaluation process. We encourage you to continue to monitor SAM.gov for all future updates, draft releases, and formal announcements regarding this requirement. Thank you again for your time, interest, and continued support of this mission. 10 June 2026 Updated: U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) Decision At this time, the acquisition strategy has not been approved. Unfortunately, this process has taken longer than initially anticipated, and the Government is still actively working through the approval process. However, we are able to share an update regarding the SBA's decision: The SBA has officially released the two previous contracts�WICS II and PEDS�from the 8(a) program. Concurrently, the initially approved consolidated Justification and Approval (J&A) decision has been changed. Therefore, the CNECTS acquisition will now be competed as a 100% Small Business Set-Aside. Thank you all for your continued interest in the CNECTS acquisition. We appreciate your patience as we finalize the remaining acquisition strategy approvals. All interested parties are advised to continue to monitor SAM.gov for all formal notifications, updated timelines, and future releases of information regarding this requirement. 01 May 2026 Updated: Release of Consolidated Questions and Answers (Q&As) and Updated PEDS PWS. description: Talland College heeft sinds de zomer van 2024 Microsoft Dynamics 365 in gebruik als CRM-systeem. De initiële inrichting en toepassing van het CRM-systeem is gerealiseerd binnen het team Marketing & Communicatie. Binnen de organisatie bestaat de wens om Microsoft Dynamics 365 organisatiebreed in te zetten. In eerste instantie richt deze uitbreiding zich op het domein Leven Lang Ontwikkelen (LLO), waarbij de focus vergroot van studentenwerving voor het reguliere opleidingsaanbod naar het werven/bedienen van werkende professionals en externe relaties voor bedrijfsopleidingen en om- en bijscholingstrajecten. De totale raming over de gehele looptijd van de raamovereenkomst van maximaal 10 jaar bedraagt € 1.200.000 (exclusief BTW), bestaande uit: Eenmalige inrichtingskosten LLO met een volledige uitvoering (inclusief de koppelingen LLO) in de eerste 24 maanden na definitieve gunning is begroot op maximaal € 320.000 en zijn daarmee een plafondbedrag. Jaarlijkse kosten beheer/support zijn begroot op € 30.000 en daarna jaarlijks geïndexeerd. Jaarlijkse mutaties op de inrichting zijn begroot op € 40.000 en daarna jaarlijks geïndexeerd.
